jobs.occupation: Commercial Territory Manager, Northern Europe & APAC
jobs.description:
Secomea is growing rapidly across EMEA to meet the growing demand for secure, reliable access in manufacturing.

Secomea is hiring an ambitious Commercial Territory Manager to build out our market in Northern Europe & APAC and help accelerate our growth across one of Europe's most important industrial regions.

This is a true full-cycle sales role. You'll be responsible for generating your own pipeline, qualifying opportunities, managing the sales process from first meeting to signature, and closing new business.

If you're a top-performing Senior BDR looking for your first closing role, or an early-career Account Executive ready for more ownership, this is an opportunity to accelerate your sales career in one of the fastest-growing sectors in enterprise technology.

**Your Role

**As Commercial Territory Manager, you'll own the Nothern European & APAC territory, selling Secomea's Secure Remote Access platform to manufacturers, machine builders and system integrators. This position reports to Secomea’s Regional Manager for Northern Europe/APAC.

You'll build and execute your territory plan, develop new opportunities, manage a healthy sales pipeline, and accurately forecast your business. You'll work closely with our partner network while leading the sales process and building long-term customer relationships.

You'll receive support from our SDR team, marketing, and presales - but success in this role will come from your ability to hunt independently, create pipeline, run a disciplined sales process, and win new business.

This role offers significant autonomy, responsibility, and visibility, making a direct impact on Secomea's continued growth across EMEA.

**What You'll Do

**

• Own and execute the commercial strategy for the Nothern European and APAC territory.

• Generate qualified pipeline through outbound prospecting, networking, partner collaboration, and territory planning.

• Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting and discovery through demonstrations, commercial negotiations, and closing a signed agreement.

• Build strong relationships with manufacturers, machine builders, system integrators, and channel partners.

• Collaborate with partners to identify and develop new business opportunities.

• Work closely with SDRs, Marketing, Presales, and Customer Success to maximize customer success and revenue growth.

• Maintain an accurate sales forecast and disciplined pipeline management in Salesforce and Clari.

• Achieve and exceed quarterly and annual ARR targets.

• Travel within the Northern region to meet customers and partners, as appropriate.

**What We're Looking For

**We're less interested in years of experience than we are in evidence that you can build pipeline and win business. We want to see the enthusiasm, curiosity, and energy required to thrive in this type of role.

**We imagine you will have:

**

• 1-5 years of B2B sales experience in software, SaaS, industrial technology, cybersecurity or a related technical industry.

• Experience selling to companies HQ’d in Nothern Europe & APAC

• Deep curiosity and desire to understand the people and organizations you work with.

• Experience prospecting and generating your own pipeline.

• Experience managing opportunities through the full sales cycle and closing deals involving MSA, MFA, SoW, and other important paper process.

• Experience achieving or exceeding sales quota.

• Confidence managing forecasts and maintaining CRM hygiene.

• Experience working with sales methodologies (MEDDPPIC; Challenger etc.) is an advantage.

• Experience working with channel partners is a strong advantage.

• Experience selling into manufacturing, industrial automation, OT or cybersecurity is a strong advantage.

**Languages:

**Because you'll operate in an international environment:

• Native or near-native English is essential.

• Dutch is a clear advantage.

**Who You Are:

**

• Competitive and driven by winning new business.

• Resilient, proactive, and focused

• Curious, coachable and eager to develop into a top-performing sales professional.

• Comfortable picking up the phone, prospecting and creating opportunities.

• Highly organized with strong forecasting and pipeline management skills.

• Comfortable selling technical solutions with support from our presales team.

**Why Join Secomea?

**This is an opportunity to join a high-performing sales team in a company with strong product-market fit whilst operating in one of the fastest-growing areas of industrial technology/cybersecurity.

You'll join an environment that will be a springboard to developing into a highly successful salesperson. Expect coaching, constructive feedback, and autonomy, whilst helping global manufacturers secure their critical operations.

**We offer:

**

• A true full-cycle sales role with significant ownership.

• Career progression into larger territory or enterprise sales roles.

• Competitive salary and uncapped commission.

• A fast-growing international company making a real impact in OT cybersecurity.

**About Secomea

**Secomea is a global leader in secure remote access and Operational Technology (OT) cybersecurity for manufacturing.

Our platform enables manufacturers, machine builders and system integrators to securely connect to industrial equipment anywhere in the world, reducing downtime while protecting critical infrastructure.

Headquartered in Denmark with offices across North America, Europe and Asia, Secomea serves customers through a global network of partners and continues to expand rapidly as industrial cybersecurity becomes a strategic priority.

**Ready to Apply?

**If you're looking for the opportunity to build your own pipeline, and accelerate your career in B2B technology sales, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today with your CV. Or show us how you’d approach a prospective customer by finding and reaching out to the hiring manager.

jobs.occupation: Internship in Water Ecosystem and Business Development
jobs.description:
Would you like to be part of Kamstrup Water’s business development journey, and do you have a passion for solutions that drive sustainable growth? Are you ready to get hands-on experience with Business Development while working on the digital footprint within our Water division? Do you want to kick-start your career and turn your theoretical knowledge into practical experience in an international company?

Here is what the job entails

As an intern in our Water Ecosystem and Business Development team, you will collaborate closely with experienced colleagues to shape the next generation of solutions for water utilities. Your work will focus on exploring the right technologies, markets, and potential partners during the innovation phase. This includes identifying impactful solutions, creating pilots, and generating value propositions and business cases to guide future priorities.

More specifically you will be:

• Conducting desk research to investigate competitive solutions, markets, and potential partners.

• Participating in workshops and webinars to gain insights and foster collaboration.

• Contributing to idea generation sessions with customers or stakeholders to drive innovation.

• Supporting the development of business cases for promising opportunities.

• Assisting in managing projects related to the development and implementation of new solutions.

Meet your future team

You will become a part of a department, that focuses on Business Development within Kamstrup Water business unit. The team consists of 2 dedicated employees and a student worker and is characterized by a youthful atmosphere where new ideas and sparring are the backbone of everything we do. The department is responsible for the expansion and growth of future solutions in the water solutions portfolio on a global scale.

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for an analytical-minded student who strives to create valuable commercial impact on our Water business unit. You have a commercial focus combined with a solution orientation mindset which empowers you to translate customer challenges into solutions.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Are studying Global Business Engineering, Business & Water Technology, or a relevant MSc in Economics and Business Administration, Business Development, Business Management, Digital Business Management, or similar. That being said, there are many entry points to this position

• As a person have a curious and creative mindset, allowing you to proactively seek new knowledge and thereby provide new ideas and challenge status quo

• Have a structured approach to your work, enabling you to manage several ongoing tasks while maintaining an overview

• Naturally strive towards ensuring quality results whether you are collaborating with colleagues or working independently

As we are an international organisation it is important that you are fluent in English.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We offer more than just an internship

At Kamstrup, your contribution as an intern is highly valued, and we cherish the good colleagueship. Therefore, you will experience an internship with a strong focus on your individual development through challenging tasks, career sparring, voluntary courses, as well as social events and a large network. We are proud, that our internship program has resulted in Studenterhus Aarhus granting us with the Mentor Award, the Internationalization Award, the Jury’s Special Award and the award for East Jutland’s Best Internship.

Besides the best program, we also offer:

• A gratuity which may be provided in recognition of your efforts if your place of study allows it as well as paid public transportation to and from work

• Multiple internship events and weekly internship lunches

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association, that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

The applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, but you can expect a response within six weeks. Any details about the internship will be individually agreed upon. However, the internship is expected to run from the beginning of February 2027 until the end of June 2027.

Kamstrup is located in Stilling south of Aarhus, and bus number 200 takes you right to the door.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Business Development Manager, Amalie Lund, on telephone nr.: +45 89 93 10 00.

At Complir we are building the system to enable safer physical products being sold across markets. The world of product compliance has been stuck in legacy systems, excel sheets and the brains of experts. The increasing amount of regulations and complexity is breaking these old systems, making it increasingly hard to sell safe compliant products to consumers. We are building the product that enables compliance experts to stay afloat.

We are a small team of generalists working on all parts of the stack. One day you might be working on improving the reliability of our AI systems, another you might be tweaking the UI of the product. Our team is one of high trust, collaboration and autonomy, therefore we’re looking for engineers who thrive when given responsibility from day one and are not afraid to figure out things on their own. We ship early and iterate directly with customers, therefore you will be expected to be comfortable talking directly to the users using the software you will build.

****Location

****Our office is located in Copenhagen and you will be expected to work in person. We will provide the necessary help with relocation if needed.

****Day to day at Complir

• You will be working directly with the founders, customers and our in house specialists and you will help figure out what needs to be built

• Build AI native software that integrates with the latest models to solve our customers' hardest problems. (we have plenty of tokens)

• Build durable workflows to understand customers' unstructured data.

• Improve the data structures that connects cross border regulatory data

• Surface novel insights from unstructured and structured data

****What we’re looking for

• At least 2-5 years of experience

• Strong understanding of React and TypeScript, with experience of working across the full stack. You understand browsers, but also the ins and outs of databases

• Product taste. You have opinions about UI/UX and enjoy iterating to get to the correct product shape

• High agency. You take responsibility and are able to work without a PM giving you tickets

• Experience working at a startup

****What we offer

• Small collaborative team. We work hard but have a lot of fun. We are a diverse set of people with different backgrounds

• Employee friendly equity package

• Competitive salary

• Work at a venture backed startup. Read our latest 11m seed round led by GC here: https://www.complir.io/resources/news/complir-raises-11m-seed

• Assistance with relocation if need be

• 0 -> 1 work. Have real influence on how the product is shaped and work on green field projects

Are you curious about how digital regulation and regulatory compliance come to life in an international technology company? Would you like to contribute to meaningful legal work within areas such as data protection, AI, cybersecurity and technology law while learning from experienced professionals along the way? Are you ready to kick-start your career with a student job that combines digital regulation with real responsibility?

Here is what the job entails

In this role, you will gain practical experience with digital regulation and regulatory compliance through hands-on legal tasks while supporting our Regulatory Compliance team. You will contribute to a wide range of legal and compliance activities that help ensure the organisation meets its regulatory obligations and supports responsible business practices.

More specifically, you will be:

• Conducting legal research and information searches within data protection and other areas of digital regulation

• Contributing to practical compliance activities, including preparing and maintaining legally required data protection documentation

• Assisting in drafting, reviewing and updating data processing agreements and other compliance-related documentation

• Supporting the ongoing oversight of data processors and sub-processors to help ensure compliance with applicable data protection requirements

• Contributing to other legal and regulatory matters based on the team’s priorities and ongoing projects.

In this role, you will join an engaged and collaborative team that supports your development while giving you plenty of opportunities to learn and take on meaningful responsibility. You will also gain valuable insight into how regulatory compliance informs business decisions and supports strategic initiatives across an international technology company.

Meet your future team

You will become part of our Regulatory Compliance team within the Commercial & Legal Services Department. Together, we help Kamstrup navigate legal and regulatory requirements while supporting the company’s strategic goals and international activities. Our team is characterised by close collaboration, open communication and mutual support. Knowledge sharing and professional discussions are a natural part of our everyday work, and we value curiosity, positivity, engagement and different perspectives.

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for a motivated and curious student who is eager to apply legal knowledge in practice while bringing your own perspectives and ideas to the team. You have a desire to learn while also being curious about how legal and regulatory requirements shape business decisions. Most importantly, you bring a positive attitude, a genuine desire to contribute to the team's success, and a strong engagement, allowing you to go the extra mile during peak periods.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Are currently studying law or business law and have completed at least the 5th semester of the degree

• Have a strong interest in developing your knowledge of data protection, regulatory compliance and digital legislation

• Are comfortable conducting legal research and analysing complex information

• Pay attention to details and are committed to delivering high-quality work

• Communicate effectively and can collaborate and build strong relationships across different functions

As we are an international organization it is important that you are fluent in English and Danish.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, you could still be a good candidate for the position. If you find the role intriguing, do not hesitate to apply.

We are more than an ordinary workplace

We offer a challenging student job in an international company where you are given independent responsibility for specific assignments, and where you can transform your theoretical knowledge into practical experience. As a student worker, you will be treated as an integrated part of the team, equal to other employees, ensuring a steep learning curve.

Besides the best colleagues you could imagine, we also offer:

• Work-life balance through flexible working hours

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

Please submit your application by using the link below. Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, and you can expect a response within six weeks.This is a part-time position of approximately 15 hours per week. Your working hours will be agreed individually, with flexibility during examination periods.

The job will be located at Kamstrup's headquarters in Stilling, between Aarhus and Skanderborg.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Legal Counsel, Camilla Hovgaard Svare, on phone: +45 89 93 10 00.

At GetWhy, we’re on a mission to change the way brands understand people. We help the world's biggest brands get closer to their consumers—faster, smarter, and with a human touch - through breakthrough research powered by AI. Companies like Coca-Cola, Heineken, Unilever and more trust us to deliver consumer insights in hours, not weeks.

We are building an end-to-end AI-powered human insights platform, redefining the boundaries of qualitative research. To fuel our journey, we raised a $34.5M Series A investment from PeakSpan Capital in 2024, making it one of Denmark’s largest Series A rounds to date.

What the AI team does

We are dedicated to delivering high-quality AI products leveraging the latest tools and techniques and to serve them across our core products in a scalable way.

For this, we use classic machine learning for predictive models to deal with fraud detection, language classification, visual understanding and automating internal workflows. These make heavy use of video processing, speech-to-text and multilingual translations models and pipelines.

We also build a lot of functionality around state of the art LLMs. We treat off-the-shelf LLMs as future commodities and aim to benefit from their strengths while employing principled methodologies to build guardrails and fallback strategies for their weaknesses. We strive to achieve a deep understanding of prompt engineering, context management, and LLM behavior quirks (e.g., hallucinations, non-determinism, context management), by focusing on evaluation and observability through monitoring for latency, accuracy, and usage.

Who you are

We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join our growing stellar AI team. You will be responsible for all stages in the machine learning lifecycles across projects, from designing and defining data annotation steps to model training, validation and deployment.

**More Specifically, You Should Have These Minimum Qualifications

**

• At least 5+ years developing machine learning systems, in particular NLP models.

• Proficiency in Python, along with a solid understanding of data structures and algorithms, and the capability to write production-quality code.

• Significant experience working with LLMs at scale, Prompt Engineering and AI Agents.

• Solid understanding of LLM evaluation, dealing with hallucinations, inconsistent outputs, context management, conversational AI and voice technologies, including text-to-speech.

• Proven experience formulating hypotheses, conducting experiments, and analyzing results.

• Exceptional English skills, both spoken and in writing.

What you will do

• Build AI-powered features at scale using the latest advancements in LLMs.

• Research, prototype, and build advanced NLP/ML models to enable automated resolution of end-user problems.

• Design and conduct rigorous experiments and evaluations to enhance model accuracy and reliability.

• Refine prompts and tune hyper-parameters to maximize the performance of cutting-edge retrieval and generative AI systems.

• Work closely with researchers, engineers, and product teams to define feature scope and implementation strategies.

• Mentor junior team members and engage in collaborative learning with peers to promote knowledge sharing.

• Contribute to technical reviews and share expertise in ML methodologies and best practices

• Writing clean, maintainable, and well-structured code to meet delivery goals.

What we offer

• A highly ambitious AI team driven by sky-is-the-limit long term vision and goals, while working to identify and deliver intermediate milestones.

• A full-time position with a competitive salary plus benefits.

• A flexible work schedule with opportunities to work from home.

• A vibrant and international work environment with 60+ colleagues from 15+ nationalities.

• A modern, newly renovated Nordhavnen office with stunning waterfront views, office lunch, relaxation areas, gym, free daily energizers, snacks, and drinks.

• A company culture that values innovation, collaboration, and transparency.

• Annual company retreats and Friday bar events – we work hard, we celebrate hard.

How do I apply?

Click on the apply button and upload your resumé or LinkedIn profile. If we see a potential match, we’ll invite you for a conversation at our office to get to know you better and share more about our culture and this opportunity.

So, what are you waiting for? Hit the apply button and come join the next Danish unicorn.

Context & Environment

Student Assistant - Accounting

Employment: Part-time (15-20 hours weekly)

Start Date: 11-01-2027

Work-place location: Copenhagen

Application deadline: 28-10-2026

Appetizer

Come and join Denmark’s leading energy company, as we are looking for our next talent! TotalEnergies Denmark A/S is currently looking for a talented Student Assistant to support our accounting team with day-to-day finance operations. The role is connected to the branch Marketing & Services, Nordic Hub, with colleagues across all 4 Nordic countries. With more than 15 different nationalities in the Nordic Hub you will be part of a true international atmosphere and work from our attractive office premises at Amerika Plads, Copenhagen O.

We offer an opportunity to kick-start your career in a skilled and international finance environment. This position will provide real-world experience and give you the chance to develop hands-on accounting skills while supporting daily finance operations across our Nordic Hub.

You will work closely with our local accounting team and Shared Service Center in Bucharest, gain insight into vendor and customer accounting processes, and take on responsibility from day one. We look forward to sharing our knowledge with you and supporting your development.

Activities

About the role

As a Student Assistant, you will support day-to-day accounting activities across several Nordic entities. The role covers a broad range of accounting tasks, from vendor, customer accounting to reconciliations and payment processing.

Tasks and responsibilities may vary depending on business needs, and you will also receive ad-hoc assignments from the CFO and Management at large.

Key responsibilities

• Daily accounting tasks including debit and credit postings

• Processing and monitoring vendor and customer transactions

• Preparing and reviewing weekly payments

• Follow up on outstanding Receivables

• Customer Account reconciliations

• Assist Shared Service Center with payment allocations on accounts

• Assist with month-end closing activities

• Collaborating closely with the Shared Service Center

• Support audit requests and documentation gathering

• Handling ad-hoc accounting tasks from management and the CFO

Candidate Profile

Whom are we looking for?

The ideal candidate:

• Is currently studying towards a bachelor’s or master’s degree, ideally within finance, accounting, business administration, or a related field, with at least two years remaining

• Can work 15-20 hours a week, with flexibility around exams and study periods

• Has an interest in accounting and administrative finance processes

• Has an interest in or experience with data, AI, systems, or automation

• Is structured, detail-oriented, and reliable in handling documentation and data

• Is comfortable using Excel and interested in developing your skills

We imagine that you:

• Work independently and proactively, while being a strong team player

• Bring positive energy, curiosity, and motivation to learn and develop your skills

• Take a detail-oriented and accountable approach, seeing tasks through to completion

• Is comfortable working with different currencies and banks

• Communicate confidently in English and Danish – this is mandatory

• Able to communicate with stakeholders at different levels

What do we offer?

• A welcoming and international workplace where you can build your network and grow professionally

• Hands-on experience in accounting and finance, with support from experienced colleagues

• A modern office in Nordhavn in Copenhagen with a great lunch canteen (incl. breakfast) and attractive surroundings

• Access to a student assistant network across all of TotalEnergies branches in Copenhagen

• Monthly social events such as Friday bars, tastings, sports activities and other informal gatherings

• Training and learning opportunities to support your development and strengthen your future career

Application & Contact

At TotalEnergies we have an engaging and supportive work environment and can guarantee a great start to your career.

We hope to find our new Student Assistant as soon as possible and look forward to receiving your application no later than 28th of October 2026.

For role related questions, you can contact hiring manager Deborah Jørgensen, Accounting Manager via deborah.joergensen@totalenergies.com

For HR related questions, you can contact Laura Sørensen, HR Operations Coordinator via ms.nordic-hr@totalenergies.com

Come join one of the world’s major players in the global energy transition

TotalEnergies is a global integrated energy company that produces and markets energies: oil and biofuels, natural gas, biogas and low-carbon hydrogen, renewables and electricity. Active in about 120 countries, TotalEnergies places sustainability at the heart of its strategy, its projects and its operations.

Safety - Respect for Each Other - Pioneer Spirit - Stand Together - Performance Minded

Context & Environment

Join TotalEnergies EP Danmark, a key player in energy production in the North Sea.

Within the Logistics & Support to Operations (LSO) team based in Esbjerg and reporting to the Head of Methods, you will contribute to improving the subsidiary’s logistics performance through data analysis, process optimization, development of digital tools, and implementation of continuous improvement projects supporting offshore operations.

Your main responsibilities will include:

Why join us ?

Candidate Profile

You have a good knowledge of Power BI and knowledge of or interest in SAP.

Programming skills would be an asset.

A minimum C1 level of English is required. A minimum B2 level of French is also required.

Additional Information

Date de début / start date : Q4 2026 / Q1 2027

Context & Environment

At TotalEnergies, we believe that our people are our greatest strength. Joining us means becoming part of a diverse global organization where expertise, innovation, and collaboration drive our success. We offer opportunities to develop your skills, grow your career, and contribute to the energy transition while benefiting from a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package.

Are you passionate about reservoir engineering and eager to influence the development of complex oil and gas assets?

If yes, then this position at TotalEnergies in Copenhagen could be your next career move.

We are looking for a Senior Reservoir Engineer to join our Reservoir Engineering team. In this role, you will contribute to high-value subsurface studies, reservoir management activities, reserves evaluations and development projects across a diverse international asset portfolio.

You will work in a multidisciplinary environment alongside geologists, geophysicists, drilling and wells professionals, production engineers and development teams, helping to deliver innovative and fit-for-purpose technical solutions that support both business performance and long-term value creation.

Activities

Key Responsibilities

As a Senior Reservoir Engineer, you will:

• Validate and interpret reservoir data to support field and discovery evaluations.

• Coordinate specialist studies required for the construction and maintenance of reservoir simulation models.

• Perform reservoir simulations and dynamic reservoir analyses in partnership with geologists and geophysicists.

• Develop production forecasts, reserves evaluations and uncertainty assessments for development scenarios.

• Identify opportunities for reservoir optimisation, field redevelopment and future appraisal programmes.

• Support integrated asset studies and contribute to decision-making on field development projects.

• Apply advanced reservoir engineering methodologies and simulation techniques when required.

• Present technical recommendations and study outcomes to stakeholders and governance forums.

• Mentor and coach junior reservoir engineers and contribute to capability development across the organisation.

• Promote strong HSE behaviours and continuous improvement in all activities.

Candidate Profile

Who We Are Looking For

You thrive in a technically challenging and collaborative environment. You enjoy solving complex subsurface problems, influencing multidisciplinary teams and delivering practical solutions that create business value.

We are looking for a strong team player who demonstrates curiosity, initiative and the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to a broad range of stakeholders.

Your Background

We expect that you have:

• A master's degree, PhD or equivalent qualification in Reservoir Engineering, Petroleum Engineering or a related discipline.

• Approximately 10 to 15 years of reservoir engineering experience.

• Strong experience in reservoir simulation and dynamic reservoir modelling.

• Proven ability to work autonomously within reservoir engineering activities.

• Experience participating in integrated subsurface studies and field development projects.

• Operational experience within asset teams, affiliates or integrated geoscience and reservoir studies.

• Strong communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills.

• Experience mentoring and coaching less experienced engineers.

• Professional fluency in English.

Total Rewards Package

As part of our commitment to fair and transparent remuneration practices, the base salary range for this position is DKK 828.000 - 1.104.000 annually, reflecting the expected level and scope of the role.

In addition to the base salary, we offer an annual performance-based bonus, pension contribution, employee share ownership program participation, wellbeing and insurance benefits, flexible working practices, training and development opportunities.

The final salary offer will be determined based on objective criteria such as qualifications, relevant experience, competencies, role scope, responsibilities, organizational needs, and market alignment.

About TotalEnergies in Denmark

TotalEnergies has been active in Denmark for more than 50 years and is one of the country's leading energy companies. With approximately 1,000 employees across Copenhagen, Esbjerg and offshore locations, we play a significant role in Denmark's energy supply while supporting the transition towards lower-carbon energy solutions.

Contact

For questions regarding this position, please contact Talent Developer Gulmaral Bokayeva at Gulmaral.Bokayeva@totalenergies.com

We look forward to receiving your application no later than 21 October 2026.

We are looking forward to your application!

jobs.occupation: Student Assistant for Cyber Defence Center
jobs.description:

We are Denmark’s leading business specialist on cyber security. Our industry knowledge, product expertise and creativity, combined with high-quality customer service, is our business foundation. Therefore, we value having the right employees, where we focus on developing and upskilling their individual talent.

We are currently looking for talented students for tasks with cyber security monitoring in Cyber Defence Center.

We offer

• Opportunity to work in of one Denmarks leading companies within cyber security

About you

It is an advantage if you have knowledge within the following subjects:
